# Floor plan (`floor-plan`)

A plan of rooms as shapes you can tap, coloured or lit by their state, with markers for devices.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createFloorPlan` (types in `dist/web/home/rooms/floorPlan.d.ts`): `.mh-floor-plan`: rooms as `<polygon>` shapes in an SVG scaled to fit (`__canvas` keeps the plan's aspect ratio), names in an HTML layer on top (`__labels`, theme type at any scale) and device markers (`__marker`, buttons with `onMarker`). Each room is a `g.mh-floor-plan__room` with `role="button"`: lit rooms (`.is-lit`, `--_level`) glow in the lit-light colour, `.is-heat` / `.is-cool` take a warm or cool tint, `.is-alert` a danger outline. Alert, selected and focus outlines are drawn in a ring layer above every room. One tab stop; arrow keys move to the nearest room or marker in that direction, Home and End to the first and last, Enter or Space chooses.

```ts
export function createFloorPlan(options: FloorPlanOptions): FloorPlanHandle;

export interface FloorPlanOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the plan ("Ground floor"). */
  label: string;
  rooms: readonly FloorPlanRoom[];
  markers?: readonly FloorPlanMarker[];
  /** The area to show, in plan units (default: everything, fitted). */
  bounds?: FloorPlanBounds | null;
  /** The chosen room: outlined in the accent, `aria-current`. */
  selected?: string | null;
  /** Draw room names (and summaries) on the plan (default true). Off for small screens. */
  showNames?: boolean;
  /** A room was tapped or chosen with Enter or Space. */
  onRoom?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Makes the markers buttons. */
  onMarker?: (id: string) => void;
}

export interface FloorPlanHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<FloorPlanOptions>): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiDoor, mdiFloorLamp } from '@mdi/js';
import { createFloorPlan, type FloorPlanMarker, type FloorPlanRoom } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Shapes are in centimetres; the plan scales them to fit.
const rooms: FloorPlanRoom[] = [
  { id: 'living', name: 'Living room', shape: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 500, height: 400 }, light: 70 },
  { id: 'kitchen', name: 'Kitchen', shape: { x: 500, y: 0, width: 300, height: 250 }, summary: '22 °C' },
  { id: 'hall', name: 'Hall', shape: { x: 500, y: 250, width: 300, height: 150 } },
  { id: 'bedroom', name: 'Bedroom', shape: { x: 0, y: 400, width: 450, height: 300 }, climate: 'heat' },
  { id: 'bath', name: 'Bathroom', shape: { x: 450, y: 400, width: 350, height: 300 }, alert: true },
];

let markers: FloorPlanMarker[] = [
  { id: 'lamp', x: 90, y: 90, icon: mdiFloorLamp, label: 'Floor lamp', state: 'On', active: true, tone: 'warm' },
  { id: 'door', x: 790, y: 325, icon: mdiDoor, label: 'Front door', state: 'Locked' },
];

const plan = createFloorPlan({
  label: 'Ground floor',
  rooms,
  markers,
  onRoom: (id) => plan.update({ selected: id }),
  onMarker: (id) => {
    if (id !== 'lamp') return;
    markers = markers.map((m) => (m.id === id ? { ...m, active: !m.active, state: m.active ? 'Off' : 'On' } : m));
    plan.update({ markers });
  },
});

document.body.append(plan.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiDoor, mdiFloorLamp } from '@mdi/js';
import { FloorPlan } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { FloorPlanRoom } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Shapes are in centimetres; the plan scales them to fit.
const rooms: FloorPlanRoom[] = [
  { id: 'living', name: 'Living room', shape: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 500, height: 400 }, light: 70 },
  { id: 'kitchen', name: 'Kitchen', shape: { x: 500, y: 0, width: 300, height: 250 }, summary: '22 °C' },
  { id: 'hall', name: 'Hall', shape: { x: 500, y: 250, width: 300, height: 150 } },
  { id: 'bedroom', name: 'Bedroom', shape: { x: 0, y: 400, width: 450, height: 300 }, climate: 'heat' },
  { id: 'bath', name: 'Bathroom', shape: { x: 450, y: 400, width: 350, height: 300 }, alert: true },
];

export function FloorPlanExample() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lampOn, setLampOn] = useState(true);
  const lamp = { id: 'lamp', x: 90, y: 90, icon: mdiFloorLamp, label: 'Floor lamp', tone: 'warm' as const };
  return (
    <FloorPlan
      label="Ground floor"
      rooms={rooms}
      markers={[
        { ...lamp, state: lampOn ? 'On' : 'Off', active: lampOn },
        { id: 'door', x: 790, y: 325, icon: mdiDoor, label: 'Front door', state: 'Locked' },
      ]}
      selected={selected}
      onRoom={setSelected}
      onMarker={(id) => {
        if (id === 'lamp') setLampOn((on) => !on);
      }}
    />
  );
}
```
